name: Arashima Honoka
source: The daughter of the owner of the video rental store "Kokonoka" that Makoto works part-time at. She's a reliable person that's kind to everyone, and is the class president. Her father is always nagging her to get married, and he recognizes her and Makoto as a couple even though they aren't in a relationship. She helps out a lot in the store, but doesn't go near the adult corner.
